threads.body: [Build] This makes every servlet-image Gradle invocation fail during configuration. `latestJava` is included in several target matrices, but `configureImage()` only maps HotSpot Windows/Linux and OpenJ9 images through JDK 26 (lines 308, 318, and 333), so JDK 27 reaches an `Unexpected jdk version` exception before any image can build. Add pinned JDK 27 mappings for all selected VM/platform combinations before advancing this marker, or keep it at 26.
threads.hunk:
@@ -27,7 +27,7 @@ gradle.sharedServices.registerIfAbsent("dockerBuildService", DockerBuildService:
 val extraTag = findProperty("extraTag")
   ?: java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd.HHmmSS").format(java.time.LocalDateTime.now())
 
-val latestJava = "26" // renovate(java-version)
+val latestJava = "27" // renovate(java-version)
